subject: HWE-11 application digital-twin laboratory
notRealApplicationSupport: A twin models an application; it is not one. No licensed application, real GUI toolkit, real display or real input device was involved. This proves route selection, unsafe-downgrade refusal, ground-truth verification, interruption, cancellation, emergency stop and rollback behave correctly against adversarial models. It proves NOTHING about driving real applications and must never be promoted to REAL TARGET RUNTIME VERIFIED.
